questions.text: How will you know the tool has successfully helped clarify what's missing from your product plan?
questions.rationale: Understanding success criteria is foundational — without it we cannot define constraints or acceptance standards.

options.label: You've identified gaps in planning you want to address
The gaps guide your next research or specification steps
You feel more confident about your product's completeness

questions.text: What criteria should the tool use to identify genuine gaps in a product plan?
questions.rationale: Gap detection logic is the core behavior — knowing what makes something 'missing' determines how the entire tool functions.

options.label: Topics commonly covered in product planning that haven't been mentioned
Incomplete connections or dependencies between topics
Vague or underdeveloped answers needing more specificity
Conflicting or inconsistent information across the plan

questions.text: What dimensions of product knowledge should the tool assess for completeness?
questions.rationale: Knowing what to track is foundational for gap detection and determines what the tool can meaningfully evaluate.

questions.text: How should users input what they know about their product?
questions.rationale: Input method affects interface design, data availability for analysis, and shapes what gaps can be detected.

options.label: Conversation where the tool asks follow-up questions
